correctness.rationale: Identity-block injection makes the message sum exact. Splitting by s=sum(u_i) gives B for s=0 from an additive-character zero-sum projector; for s!=0 each pair (u_i,s-u_i) has weight one for exactly v=0 or s, and its Fourier polynomial F_{a,s} is explicit. Expanding F_{a,s}^k and evaluating the root-of-unity sum by gcd(q,j-1) gives H, valid for arbitrary composite q. The extra final coordinate raises only the nonzero-sum weights. Direct enumeration for 41 pairs and integer arithmetic for 1421 parameter pairs reproduces the formulas, published full-support expressions and claimed weight-four count; the symbolic derivation proves the infinite family. No unproved lemma is needed.

value.rationale: Both integral spike-code families are motivated by a current primary paper that established distances and full-support counts but not the full ordinary Hamming spectrum. Every coefficient is an intrinsic coding invariant; a uniform formula for arbitrary k and composite q is a natural complete classification that exposes gcd-residue effects, avoids q^k enumeration, and gives an exact minimum-word count in the full k>=5 regime. This is not a small random slice or repackaging of the known top coefficient.
